source.snippet: We are using Salesforce Revenue Cloud Advanced with Product Configurator... We need existing Assets related to the Quote's Account to affect the Quote in two scenarios. Scenario 1: Make a bundle child component free [when the account already owns a particular Asset product]. The following settings are enabled: Set Up Configuration Rules with Business Rules Engine, Set Up Configuration Rules and Constraints with Constraints Engine...

problem_statement: Salesforce Revenue Cloud Advanced CPQ admins and developers cannot easily configure asset-aware bundle discounts and conditional required products without deep expertise in the Business Rules Engine and Constraints Engine, leading to expensive consulting hours or stalled deals.
target_segment: Salesforce admins and developers at mid-market to enterprise companies running Revenue Cloud Advanced / CPQ
notes: Buyer context is strong: Revenue Cloud Advanced is a high-cost Salesforce product; users are paid admins/devs at companies with active Salesforce contracts. Pain is configuration complexity that typically requires expensive consultants. Opportunity: guided configuration templates, diagnostic tooling, or a managed service layer for asset-driven pricing rules. Single data point — needs corroboration.
